scope: Managed file safety — anchored reads/captures, pinned write parents, Git fd source paths — first-stage shared platform readiness (docs/plantree/plans/001-reader-product/topics/windows-cross-platform-architecture.md §6 exit gate, capability id safe-file-io)

capabilitySelector.binding: selectCapability({capability:'safe-file-io', implementations:{linux:linuxFilesystemAdapter}}) inside selectFilesystemAdapter(); 'available' only for matrix 'implemented'; 'not-run'/'unsupported'/unknown platforms receive unsupportedFilesystemAdapter (every operation rejects FS_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED with {contract, capability, platform, operation, status, reason})

operations.openAnchoredFile(root, rel): pin every ancestor via O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW opened through /proc/self/fd; open entry O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK; returns null exactly when the entry or an ancestor is missing; entry {stat(bigint), stream(), fdSourcePath(), verify(), close()}; verify() compares dev/ino/size/mtimeNs/ctimeNs/nlink of the open inode and its directory entry plus dev/ino of every pinned ancestor and reports {stable, reason: file|entry|ancestor|missing} without deciding policy
operations.openWriteParent(root, rel): pin the parent directory (mkdir missing intermediates under the pin); returns {openExclusive(name,{mode})→FileHandle 'wx', writeExclusive(name,data,{mode}), renameOver(from,to), remove(name), close()}; names validated as single safe components (FS_NAME_REJECTED otherwise)

adapters.durability: no fsync barrier in this contract by design: anchored writes rely on the caller's durable intent manifest (documentIntent/publicationIntent reconcile-on-recovery); generic persistence barriers are the separate durable-persistence capability (platform/shared/persistence.mjs)

adapters.operations: full contract surface, every operation rejects FS_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED before any I/O; never a placeholder mac/win adapter, never a silent downgrade

contract.policy: safeRelativePath (structural: no '..', '.', backslash, control chars, >1024, absolute), writablePath (+ .git/.nozeli roots and credential material incl. .env*/auth.json/credentials*/secrets/tokens/id_rsa|ed25519|ecdsa[.pub]/*.pem|key|p12|pfx|keystore), capturePath (+ snapshot exclusion .git/.nozeli/.ccb/node_modules/.venv/venv/__pycache__), TEXT_MAX_BYTES=32MiB, git mode mapping (exec bit → 100755/100644), error codes PATH_REJECTED/SOURCE_CHANGED/TEXT_LIMIT preserved verbatim
contract.io: withSafeFile(root,rel,consume) orchestrates adapter open→policy checks→consume({stat,mode,stream,fdSourcePath})→adapter verify→policy error mapping ('文件读取期间变化/父目录变化/消失'); inspectFile (streaming digest+size+mode, no byte cap); readSafeBytes (bounded 32MiB); safeBytes (bytes|null); openWriteParent (writablePath-gated); createFileStream({filesystem}) injection; default = selectFilesystemAdapter()
contract.gitFdSourcePaths: git-service blobFiles feeds 'git hash-object -w --no-filters --stdin-paths' with fdSourcePath() lines (/proc/<pid>/fd/<fd>) so Git hashes the exact pinned inodes; SOURCE_CHANGED if object ids disagree with the streamed digests

callerMigrations.change: /proc/self/fd mechanics + bigint identity verification extracted to platform/linux/filesystem.mjs; policy and error contract unchanged; explicit adapter injection via createFileStream

constructor(store,{filesystem}) injection; local documentParent (with /proc prefix) deleted → this.files.openWriteParent at documentOperation/applyReviewedFiles/installFile/reconcileDocument; inspectFile/safeBytes/indexDigest through this.files; acceptanceCommit receives {filesystem}; SAFE_OPEN_UNSUPPORTED platform branch removed (adapter selection owns it)

blobFiles '/proc/'+process.pid+'/fd/'+fd literal → file.fdSourcePath() from the boundary; hook executability platform branch (win32||exec-bit) → hookWouldExecute(stat,{filesystem}); acceptanceCommit(...,{filesystem})
workPath import migrated to file-stream (writablePath alias); inspectFile already there

phase2AdapterSignatures.windows adapter (W1): must provide openAnchoredFile with equivalent observable identity guarantees (reparse-point/refusal semantics, final-entry identity verified after streaming, ancestor stability) and openWriteParent single-component exclusive temp + rename publish; fdSourcePath equivalent must feed Git the pinned identity (or the Git capture path must be redesigned with equivalent proof); declare capabilities.hooksExecuteRegardlessOfModeBits=true only after MinGit hook behavior is verified on a real Windows host; update platform-capabilities matrix win32 safe-file-io from 'unsupported' to 'implemented' only with real-host regression evidence
phase2AdapterSignatures.macos adapter (M1): same anchored identity/publish contract using verified native primitives (symlink/ directory-replacement and file-identity checks must be designed and measured on real macOS, not inferred from Linux /proc behavior); no /proc assumptions; matrix darwin row only flips with real-host evidence

tests.command: node --test tests/platform-filesystem.test.mjs (run from apps/desktop; register in package.json alongside core-file-stream if desired)
tests.coverage: matrix-honest selection; unsupported-platform structured rejection for reads AND writes; Pi path policy (writable vs capture distinction); anchored read digest/size/mode, missing→null; non-regular/hardlink(nlink)/oversize/symlink refusals; in-flight file and ancestor change detection; pinned write-parent redirect race (symlink swap lands in held dir, outside sentinel untouched); single-component name guard; crash-window temp creation/cleanup/recovery; Git fd source-path end-to-end (blobFile digest/oid/mode via pinned fds); worktree-dependencies provisioning through chain.* incl. npm symlink materialization, idempotent re-provision 'present', source untouched, DEPENDENCY_PLATFORM on unsupported adapter; hook executability platform semantics; ExecutionWorkspace CAS (STALE_VERSION keeps external replacement) and unsupported-adapter explicit rejection

residualBoundariesObserved.note: Durable publish is persistence-barrier shaped (temp wx + fsync + CAS recheck + rename-or-link + O_DIRECTORY dirsync) on user-chosen external paths with realpath identity, not anchored-managed-tree semantics. NOT yet in the shared residual list; needs durable-persistence contract extension {mode, createOnly, beforeCommit} to migrate. Flagged to Main.

integrate()/initializeRepository() Git ref/index publish still uses plain-path POSIX durability (fs.open wx, write+fsync, rename, O_DIRECTORY dirsync). Identity safety is anchored via inspectFile; the fsync barrier itself belongs to the durable-persistence contract once it grows a CAS/lock-aware variant. Linux-verified; explicit failure (not silent skip) elsewhere.
O_NOFOLLOW reads with post-open stat verification and non-win32-only directory fsync; separate persistence consumers, not yet on the shared barrier.
Own O_NOFOLLOW+nlink==1 bounded read for report sources; candidate to reuse withSafeFile/inspectFile from the boundary in a later pass (behavior identical today).
Synchronous O_NOFOLLOW snapshot read with nlink=0 tolerance for atomic replace; own policy, not behind the boundary.
POSIX lstat/realpath/bigint-stat identity checks in read/list policies; Linux-verified soft residuals, no /proc dependency.
